title: Automated Legacy Refactoring for Financial Systems
business: Global financial institutions maintaining massive, monolithic COBOL-based ledger systems.
problem: Manual refactoring of legacy codebases is error-prone, slow, and requires specialized knowledge that is increasingly scarce, leading to high operational risk during system updates.
solution: GPT-6 Sol provides a high-reasoning agentic framework capable of parsing multi-million line repositories, mapping dependencies, and generating modern, modular code equivalents using the Responses API for iterative verification.
steps: Ingest the legacy codebase into the context window using the 1,050,000 token capacity to establish a global dependency map.
Configure the Responses API with high reasoning_effort to analyze logic flow and identify modular boundaries.
Execute iterative code generation cycles using the apply_patch tool to propose and validate refactored segments.
Perform automated unit testing against the generated code to ensure functional parity with the original ledger logic.
outcome: A modernized, maintainable codebase that preserves critical financial logic while reducing technical debt and enabling faster deployment cycles.
limitation: The model may experience increased latency and higher token costs when processing extremely large repositories; developers must monitor the reasoning_effort parameter to balance depth of analysis against execution speed.

code.content:
client.responses.create(
    model='gpt-6-sol',
    reasoning_effort='high', # Ensures deep analysis of legacy logic
    messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Refactor this ledger module.'}],
    tools=[{'type': 'apply_patch'}] # Uses tool to modify codebase
)
